notes: "Two frustrations often appeared together in my work. A deck could look complete while missing the point I wanted to make. Changing two pages in fifty could also leave another full copy. I separated those concerns: where does the human intent stay, and which page actually changed? Story keeps the intent available; page identity and history keep the revision attached to the work. The filenames illustrate my use case, not a claim about every AI tool."

designIntent.purpose: Two frustrations often appeared together in my work
designIntent.requestedChange: Explain the product and its use; interpret the founder’s account to choose the emphasis.
keep: Keep actual product captures, original scientific data/assets, attribution and the demonstrated function. Do not fragment ordinary prose into a fake table.
